name: EPA Brownfields MARC grant application resources
description: Forms and instructions for Assessment, Cleanup and Revolving Loan Fund grants (FY 2027).

name: Elective pay for clean electricity credits: how governments can use them
description: Overview of direct pay under 48E / 45Y for local governments, schools and nonprofits. Confirm current IRS forms and pre-filing registration on irs.gov.

name: Energy community bonus: location rules
description: How the 10-point energy community adder works. The project's census tract or brownfield status still needs checking against the IRS lists.

name: USDA REAP: current status and notices
description: Rural Energy for America Program. Confirm whether a notice is open; applicants are farms and rural small businesses, not governments.

name: EPA Landfill Methane Outreach Program resources
description: Background on landfill gas-to-energy projects. Pair with the site's LMOP status in this report.

name: EPA RE-Powering: how to identify sites
description: How EPA screens contaminated land, landfills and mine lands for renewable energy. Use with the site's RE-Powering facts in this report.

name: Site access or lease agreement with the owner
description: A written right to enter and use the site. There is no single national form; use the county attorney's template or the owner's.

name: Utility interconnection or net-metering application
description: The local electric utility's form to connect generation. Get it from the utility that serves the site; there is no single national form.
